PR #56 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/projexa/pull/56

Summary of what was done:
- Confirmed via grep that `PATCH /api/org-members/[id]` is the only endpoint that can change or remove a membership's role (no DELETE route touches `memberships`; `org/provision` only inserts the first owner).
- Added a guard: before a currently owner/admin membership is moved to a non-admin role, it checks whether another owner/admin membership remains in the org, rejecting with `409` if not.
- Added 5 new tests (10/10 in that file, 40/40 repo-wide); `npx tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` both clean.
- Per the task's process constraints, this was built by locally merging in PR #53's branch (never pushed/modified) and pushing only my own branch — PR #56 explicitly notes it's meant to land on top of PR #53, not standalone.
